issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'טָמֵא לָנֶפֶשׁ' means 'unclean by reason of a dead person' (i.e., corpse contamination), but the Chinese renders it as '因接觸過性命' ('because of having touched life'), which reverses the meaning: it should be '因接觸過死人' (touching a dead person), not '性命' (life). This changes the factual claim of the verse.
